# Confessions of a Homeschooler

> A comprehensive homeschooling resource hub featuring curriculum guidance, free printables, craft tutorials, and community support from author Erica Arndt.

Confessions of a Homeschooler is a well-established platform serving homeschooling families with practical educational resources, DIY craft projects, and faith-based parenting advice. The site combines homeschool curriculum reviews, free downloadable materials, hands-on craft tutorials (quilting, cross-stitch, knitting), and a podcast featuring homeschooling tips and Q&A.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com): Homepage featuring monthly craft projects and homeschooling resources
- [About Me](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/about-me): Author bio for Erica Arndt and family introduction
- [New to Homeschooling?](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/new-to-homeschooling): Comprehensive beginner guide to homeschooling with curriculum and legal guidance
- [Why I Homeschool](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/blog/2009/09/why-i-homeschool.html): Personal testimony on Christian homeschooling philosophy and beliefs

## Homeschool Resources & Curriculum

- [Curriculum Reviews](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/curriculum-reviews): Directory of homeschool curriculum reviews and educational product comparisons
- [My Printables](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/my-printables): Library of free downloadable printables organized by subject for homeschooling
- [Calendar Printables](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/calendar-printables): Free downloadable calendar printables and learning materials for homeschoolers
- [Arts & Crafts](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/arts-crafts): Arts and crafts curriculum with artist studies and seasonal DIY projects
- [Summer Boredom Busters!](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/summer-boredom-busters): Summer activity ideas and entertainment for homeschooled children

## Craft Tutorials & Projects

- [New to Quilting & Sewing?](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/new-to-quilting): Beginner quilting and sewing guide with free courses and tutorials
- [New to Cross Stitch?](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/new-to-cross-stitch): Cross stitch beginner tutorial with patterns and project planning tools
- [New to Knit & Crochet](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/knitting): Knitting and crochet tutorials for beginners with patterns and techniques
- [Posts Archive](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/posts): Archive of craft tutorials and DIY projects including quilting and cross-stitch

## Community & Media

- [COAH Podcast](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/coah-podcast): Podcast featuring homeschooling advice, parenting tips, and Q&A sessions
- [Online Store](https://store.confessionsofahomeschooler.com): Online store selling curriculum, printables, patterns, and educational products

## Optional

- [Recipes](https://www.confessionsofahomeschooler.com/recipes): Collection of family recipes and meal planning ideas for homeschooling families
